style: Friendly and youthful, like a lab partner one grade ahead
lines: Pick an object, then tap Measure. Drag each tape from the base to the tip of its shadow.
Drag the mirror into place. Then drag the tripod until the top of the wall sits in the crosshair.
Drag the stick anywhere, then tap Measure. Drag one tape to the lamp's base and one to the shadow tip.
Both tapes are down. Tap Record to write them in the notebook.
Tap two reason cards that make the angles match.
Those two reasons make the triangles similar. Tap Reveal to see the real height.
There. The top is in the crosshair. Tap Measure, then drag the two tapes out from the mirror.
There. The top is in the crosshair. Now drag the two tapes out from the mirror.
Very close. Your triangles did the climbing.
That one's off. Check where each tape ends, then tap New trial.
Drag tape A to the stick shadow tip and tape B to the object shadow tip.
Drag tape A from the mirror to the wall base, and tape B from the mirror to the tripod.
Drag tape A from the stick to the lamp's base, and tape B to the shadow tip.
That pair does not establish two matching angles. Measure again, then choose a new pair.
Tap one more reason card to complete your angle-angle explanation.
Pick your setup, then tap Measure for a fresh reading.
Compare your readings and results in the notebook. Tap Close to return to the schoolyard.
Your estimate is recorded. Try a fresh measurement and compare it in your notebook.
The ratio agrees, but these tapes do not reach the marked endpoints. Tap New trial and measure again.
These readings are in the notebook. Move a tape for a fresh trial, or tap Why similar?
Drag the tripod until the wall top reaches the crosshair. Then lay out both tapes.
Your angle pair is recorded. Tap Reveal to return to the height comparison.
Tap Measure for two fresh readings before trying another angle pair.
Very close. Your triangles did the climbing. Tap New trial to test another setup.
Your estimate is recorded. Try a fresh measurement and compare it in your notebook. Tap New trial.
